description: Represents abandoning a task by first holding a forward position, then suddenly dropping the arm in a slump, and finally turning away to signify disengagement.
Moves to a forward position and performs two quick, sharp downward nods with the arm, mimicking a head nod to show clear agreement or confirmation.

A rapid, urgent motion to alert to danger. The arm first quickly retracts in a wind-up, then thrusts forward sharply to point at a location, holding the pose with a slight tremor to emphasize urgency.
Performs a broad, welcoming sweep to the side to indicate an open path for entry, holding the final open position.
A gesture of apology. The arm slowly moves forward and down into a low, deferential position, and holds it to show sincerity.
A clear motion of raising the arm to get attention. The arm starts from a neutral position, moves decisively upward, holds the pose, and then returns down.
Simulates one arm crossing over the chest. The arm lifts and sweeps inward, then tucks in to hold a static, defensive, or thoughtful pose.
상대를 향해 팔을 뻗은 후, 팔꿈치와 손목을 순차적으로 안쪽으로 당겨 '이쪽으로 오라'는 흐름을 생성
A decisive motion to block or stop something. The arm moves quickly forward into a barrier position, holds it firmly, and ends with a slight wrist flick to emphasize the 'stop' signal.
Draws a clear horizontal line in the air. The motion starts on one side, sweeps deliberately across the front, and ends with a slight tap, as if marking a definitive boundary.
A calming gesture. The arm starts at mid-height, then presses down slowly and deliberately, holding at the bottom to convey a 'calm down' message. This is repeated to create a soothing rhythm.
Starts in an extended offering pose, performs a quick side-to-side wrist shake to signal cancellation, then pulls the arm back decisively.
A swift, energetic upward thrust of the arm to a high point, followed by several quick pumps to express joy or victory.
Expresses a request for clarification. The arm moves to a mid-height frontal position with the palm up, then performs a gentle, questioning side-to-side tilt with the wrist.
A firm rejection motion. The arm starts centrally, then swiftly pushes out to the side and holds, ending with a small, sharp shake to emphasize the decline.
Extends the arm forward, then repeatedly pulls the forearm inward by bending the elbow, creating a clear beckoning motion.
A decisive and rapid forward reach, signifying a committed action. The arm moves quickly to a forward position and then executes a final, sharp push, holding the position to emphasize finality.

Expresses hesitant acceptance. The motion begins with a subtle side-to-side fidget, conveying contemplation. This is followed by a distinct pause, after which the arm extends forward in a deliberate gesture of agreement.
A confident power pose. The arm moves decisively to the side to rest on the 'hip', holding the position firmly with the elbow out. A final slight upward shoulder movement asserts dominance.
Creates a continuous forward rolling motion with the arm, like a wheel turning, to signal 'keep going' or 'press on'.
A motion representing a countdown. The arm starts in a raised position, then performs three distinct, sharp downward beats, as if counting '3, 2, 1'.
Represents curiosity by first extending the arm forward towards a point of interest, then performing a slow, deliberate tilt to the side, mimicking a head tilt.
A broad, sweeping gesture from one side to the other, as if indicating a wide area or directing attention across a scene.
Expresses disagreement by firmly crossing the arm across the body, holding the pose, and then releasing it back to an open position.
Represents disappointment by starting in a neutral pose, then slowly and heavily folding the arm inward and downward into a slumped, dejected position.
Expresses disbelief by quickly raising the arm to a high position, holding it there as if stunned, and then suddenly letting it drop in a gesture of resignation.
A motion representing disengagement. The arm first pulls back deliberately to create distance, then slowly droops downwards into a relaxed, final state.
A motion conveying dominance. The arm starts low, rises powerfully to a high position, then expands outward into an open posture, holding it firmly to assert presence and control.
The arm performs a preparatory upbeat motion, then executes a sharp, fast downbeat to emphasize a point, holding briefly at the bottom. This is repeated for stronger emphasis.
The arm moves to an open, extended position and then performs a wide, gentle sweep to the side, as if guiding someone or showing them the way.
The arm slowly rises to a high point with effort, pauses dramatically, and then suddenly crashes down to a low position, conveying a sense of giving up or exhaustion.
A large, fast shrug to express uncertainty or indifference. The arm lifts sharply upwards and outwards, holds at the peak, then quickly drops back down.

A motion expressing a final, firm decision. The arm first rises to a high position, pauses as if in final consideration, then executes a swift and forceful downward press, holding the final position to signify commitment.
Signals the completion of a task. The arm moves down decisively, then makes a small final gesture as if setting something down, coming to a rest.
Starts from a low position, then extends forward and upward in a single, firm motion, holding the final pose to signify decisive acceptance.
상대에게 다가가는 느낌. 어깨와 팔꿈치를 동시에 전방으로 밀어내어 물리적 거리를 좁힘
A reaction of shock or fear. The robot first freezes in place, then sharply retracts its arm backwards and downwards into a defensive posture.
Builds tension by quickly raising the arm, then slams it down forcefully in a fit of frustration, followed by a subtle tremble and a defeated hold.
A slow, smooth motion of pulling the arm backward and slightly downward, conveying a sense of creating space or disengaging in a non-confrontational manner.
Raises the arm to a visible height, then gently and slowly pushes forward in a clear 'please wait' or 'stop' signal. The motion is deliberate and non-threatening.
To express gratitude, the arm first moves to a central position. It then performs a slow, deliberate bow downwards, holds the pose to show sincerity, and finally returns to the starting position.
Raises the arm to draw attention, then smoothly points downward to a specific location, finishing with a sharp, double-tap motion to emphasize the mark.
A gentle guiding motion. The arm extends forward and then smoothly sweeps to the side to indicate a direction, holding the final pose to ensure clarity.
A motion signifying contemplation or waiting. The arm swings in a wide arc backward, then the elbow tucks the hand in to rest behind the back, holding the final position.
A motion representing placing a hand on the hip. The arm swings out to the side while the elbow bends sharply, holding a confident or impatient pose.
A motion representing disagreement or 'no'. The arm moves to a forward position and then performs a sharp, repeated side-to-side horizontal shake, mimicking a head shake.
Shows hesitation with a small stuttering motion, then slowly extends the arm halfway forward and pauses, finishing with a slight wrist turn to signify reluctant acceptance.
The robot begins to move forward as if to act, but abruptly stops and slightly retracts, holding the tense, paused position to signify hesitation or uncertainty.
Raises the arm quickly to present a 'stop' gesture, pushes forward firmly, holds the position to signal 'wait', and then slightly retracts.
Represents hesitation or contemplation. The arm extends forward, then performs a slight, rapid up-and-down trembling motion before slowly retracting slightly, as if deciding not to act.

Creates a gentle, life-like idle motion. The arm slowly drifts up and down as if breathing, then performs a slow, subtle sweep to the side to convey awareness before returning to the breathing motion.
Positions the arm as if resting on a surface, then performs a series of rapid, small wrist taps to simulate impatient finger-tapping.
높이 손을 들어 시선을 끈 뒤, 팔꿈치를 까딱거려 자신의 존재감을 알리고 대화를 끊음
Raises the arm with an open gesture and performs a smooth, horizontal sweep towards a designated area, as if presenting a seat.
A motion representing laughter. The arm shakes rapidly and rhythmically up and down, mimicking the convulsive shoulder movements of a person laughing heartily.
A motion expressing avoidance or discomfort. The arm starts in a neutral position, then pulls back and slightly down, holding the withdrawn stance as if creating distance.
The robot arm moves forward from a neutral position, mimicking a person leaning in to show interest or get a closer look. It holds the forward position to signify sustained attention.
경청: 상대방 쪽(front)으로 살짝 기울이며 정지. '관심'을 나타내는 Substitute
A deliberate motion to point towards a low area. The arm starts from a neutral position, extends downwards and forwards in a clear arc, and holds the final pose to indicate a specific spot.
A gesture to create and maintain personal space. The arm extends forward in a 'stop' motion and holds the position firmly.
A subtle, quick forward twitch of the elbow to gently draw attention or signal acknowledgement, like a small, non-verbal nudge.
Signals rejection by first retracting the arm in a brief preparatory motion, then thrusting it forward forcefully to create distance. The final extended pose is held to emphasize the boundary.
Mimics a human head nod to signify 'yes' or agreement. The arm moves to a forward position, then performs two distinct downward and upward motions with the elbow.
A motion where the arm smoothly moves across the chest to a resting position, as if contemplating or in a defensive stance.
A welcoming gesture where the arm starts from a neutral position and sweeps outwards and upwards into a wide, open stance, holding it to signify invitation or acceptance.
The arm rises decisively to point at a location high overhead, holding the pose for emphasis.
A calming gesture. The arm starts at a medium height, then slowly and firmly presses downwards, holding the final position to signify 'calm down' or 'settle'.
A gesture of offering or presenting. The arm extends forward while the wrist rotates to a palm-up orientation, holding the final pose to present something.
A direct, clear motion to indicate a direction or object. The arm lifts and extends forward decisively, holding the final pose to ensure the direction is understood.
Represents a polite bow. The arm starts from a neutral position, smoothly lowers in a deliberate arc, holds the low position to show respect, and then returns to the starting position.
A gentle forward push to signal a polite refusal or boundary. The arm extends forward slowly, holds the position to make the intent clear, and then smoothly retracts.
A preparatory motion where the arm first dips slightly, then raises deliberately to a higher position and holds, creating a sense of anticipation for an upcoming action.
A quick, reflexive motion where the arm extends forward and downwards to brace or catch something that is falling. The movement is fast and ends in a firm, held position to signify support.
A swift, firm forward extension of the arm to create a protective barrier or signal 'stop'. The motion is decisive and ends with a solid hold before slightly relaxing.
A broad, clear sweeping motion to guide attention or indicate a new path. The arm starts in front, sweeps widely to the side, and holds to establish the new direction.
Extends the arm forward in an inviting gesture, then repeatedly pulls it back by bending the elbow, as if gently beckoning someone to come closer.
Represents a release of tension. The arm first rises to a tense, held position, then suddenly drops down quickly as if letting go of a heavy burden, settling into a relaxed state.
Moves the arm to a mid-height forward position, then performs a series of small, side-to-side wrist rotations to create a gentle, repeated waving gesture.
Raises the arm to a visible height to get attention, then performs a small, repeated wrist twist to signal the desire for a turn.

A gesture to regain speaking turn. The arm starts forward, performs a quick inward flick of the wrist, and then firmly pulls the elbow back towards the body, symbolizing pulling the conversation back.

A motion indicating a reset before retrying an action. The arm moves to a central position, performs two quick, small horizontal semi-circles as if 'winding up,' and then pauses, ready for the next attempt.
A subtle gesture of satisfaction. The arm performs a quick, small inward clench, holds for a moment to savor the feeling, and then slowly relaxes.
A comforting gesture where the arm sweeps across the chest and then pulls in slightly, as if wrapping itself in a hug.

Expresses shame or shyness by first retracting the arm to a low, defensive position, pointing downwards. Then, it performs a slight, repetitive side-to-side fidgeting motion with the wrist, mimicking an attempt to hide or a nervous gesture.
A rapid, forceful motion to the side, as if protecting someone next to the robot from a sudden threat. The arm extends quickly to create a barrier and then holds the position firmly.
밀집되고 경직된 아래를 보는 모션, 이후 왼쪽 오른쪽을 살핀 뒤 부르르 진동함
A motion representing a sigh. The arm rises slightly as if taking a breath, then slowly droops downwards and forwards, as if deflating, and holds the final slumped position.
Represents a tired or dejected state. The arm starts at a neutral height, then slowly droops downwards and forwards, settling into a low, heavy position and holding it.

The arm starts from a wide side position, moves slowly and deliberately towards the center as if performing a single, slow clap, holds briefly at the center to emphasize the impact, and then returns to the side.
A calming gesture to request someone to slow down. The arm raises with the palm facing down and performs several slow, deliberate downward presses.
A gentle, rhythmic up-and-down motion from the shoulder, like a light bounce to express agreement or keep a beat.
A gesture to urge someone to hurry. It starts with a wider, slower circular motion and accelerates into a faster, tighter loop.
A quick, preparatory motion. The arm pulls back slightly then snaps forward energetically to signal the start of an action, ending in a crisp hold.
Represents a startle reflex. The arm abruptly and quickly retracts backward and upward as if flinching from a sudden stimulus, then freezes for a moment in a tense position.
A motion to signal 'stop'. The arm moves to a raised forward position, then thrusts forward assertively with the palm facing out, freezing in place to command a halt.
The arm moves to one side, then sweeps quickly and horizontally across the body to form a barrier, holding the final position to command 'stop'.
Raises the arm with a flat palm facing forward and pushes it towards the target in a clear, decisive gesture to signal 'stop'.
The arm moves to a low, non-threatening position, then slowly extends forward while rotating the wrist to present an open, upward-facing palm, holding the gesture of submission or offering.
The arm first moves quickly to the side to indicate a shift in attention, then performs a deliberate sweeping pull towards the front, as if redirecting focus.
A conducting motion to set a rhythm. The arm moves down, in, out, and up to mark a 4/4 time signature, repeating to establish a steady tempo.
Moves the arm to a chin-like position and holds it, then performs a gentle, repetitive tapping motion with the wrist to mimic a person in deep thought.
Rotates the palm to face forward, holds the position briefly, and then raises the arm in a 'stop' or presentation gesture.

Starts with the arm at a neutral mid-height, then gently lowers the arm in a gesture of deference, as if yielding a turn. The motion concludes with a slight turn of the wrist to emphasize the polite retraction.
Represents uncertainty by extending the arm forward, then stopping and holding it mid-air, followed by a slight, repetitive wavering of the wrist as if undecided.
Extends arm forward with an open, backward-facing palm, as if signaling 'stop' or 'wait'. Follows up with a gentle, repetitive pushing motion to emphasize the request.
Raises the arm to a visible height and moves it back and forth from the elbow in a classic friendly waving gesture.

A motion that offers a turn to someone. The arm starts from a neutral position, raises slightly in preparation, and then performs a wide, open sweep to the side, holding the final position to signify 'after you'.

Mimics a curious or contemplative head tilt. The arm moves to an attentive forward position, then slowly and deliberately tilts to the side by bending at the elbow, holding the position to signify curiosity or listening.
A formal gesture of respect. The arm moves swiftly to a high position near the 'head', holds it crisply, and then returns to a neutral state.
A classic friendly gesture. The arm moves to a ready position, then thrusts forward confidently, holds briefly to simulate contact, and retracts.
A motion that simulates knocking on a door. The arm raises to a mid-height forward position, then performs a series of sharp forward movements from the elbow, as if striking a surface.
